1 · Intro

When to use it.

When someone works in a state other than Tennessee, that state's rules can apply: tax withholding, unemployment insurance, workers' compensation, and wage and leave laws.

Location in Oracle is what tells payroll and benefits where the person works. Review the risks before the offer, and make sure the location is right on the position and the assignment.

Use this whenA candidate or employee will work, fully or partly, from another state.

Watch-outs

  • Never leave the location as Nashville for someone who will work elsewhere. Location drives tax, pay transparency, and benefits.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's Out of State Risk Assessment form and process are pending from engagement consultants (EC). Confirm with your EC before an offer.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC who owns each review area at Vanderbilt and the lead time for a new state.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • NYS DOL: Determination of jurisdiction (unemployment insurance for multistate workers) (opens in a new tab)
  • DOL OWCP: State workers' compensation officials (opens in a new tab)

Out of State Risk Assessment

Use when: A candidate or employee will work, fully or partly, from another state. · System: Overview

  2. State income tax withholding and registration.

  4. Workers' compensation.
  5. State wage, pay frequency, and leave laws.
  6. Set the location on the position and the assignment.
